wikitext: {{NQR Navbox}} {{Infobox league |name=NQR Season 10 |image=Nqr4-logo.gif |founder={{player|icce|flag=se}} |admin={{player|angua|flag=se}} |admin2={{player|djevulsk|flag=se}} |admin3={{player|fix|flag=fi}} et al |type=Online |format=Three split-division Group Stage into Single-Elimination Bracket |sdate=2007-02-06 |edate=2007-05-28 |website=nqr.quakeworld.nu/nqr10/ |teamfirst=Dota Allstar Guys |teamfirstflag=se |teamsecond=Clan Malfunction |teamsecondflag=fi |teamthird=Slackers |teamthirdflag=eu |teamthird2=Team Freedom |teamthird2flag=se |team_number=54 }} __NOTOC__ Season 10 sure had a few things out of the ordinary. Most notably the final, played between [[Image:flag_skan.gif]] [[Dota Allstar Guys]] and [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Clan MalFunction]], was the most spectated and broadcast game in all of QuakeWorld's history. Two different commentaries were available for this game: One of them was in English and done by [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Xerial]] and [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Sassa]], broadcast via teamspeak for the hundreds of people viewing the game via [[cam|Qizmo cams]]. The second commentary was done for Finnish television channels DigiViihde and Diggari as well as a stream on Finnish gaming website GameTV. This second commentary was consequently done by [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[JKova]], [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Mirage]] and [[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Wabbit]], in Finnish. The Gold Cup final was thus spectated by hundreds of people via Qizmo cams, by over 10.000 people via GameTV and an additional thousands of people via Satellite television. Without doubt a big moment in the history of the game, with [[Image:flag_skan.gif]] [[Dota Allstar Guys]] winning 3:0. The finals for Silver Cup and Bronze Cup had their surprises and notable moments too. While Silver Cup ended up having a surprising final between new clans [[Image:flag_eu.gif]] [[Ballistic]] and [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Core (Swedish Clan)|Core]], Bronze Cup was astonishingly won by an American clan consisting of mostly Brazilian players - [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[O Clã]] managed to defeat [[Image:flag_eu.gif]] [[Mean Machine]]. The Bronze Cup Final was commentated by [[Image:flag_se.gif]] [[Sassa]] and [[Image:flag_lu.gif]] [[Soma]].
